about_the_game:
Sunset Dunkin is a fun basketball experience for you and your friends to play.
Play quick and chaotic matches where timing your jumps, flops, and dunks matters more than actual skill. Whether your accidentally slamming into your teammates, or pulling off the perfect slow-motion slam, every round is unpredictable and hilarious.

🌅 Features:

  • Active ragdoll mayhem – physics-driven players that flop, tumble, and slam in unexpected ways.

  • Multiplayer fun – grab your friends and battle it out in fast-paced casual matches.

  • Unique courts & environments – play on floating islands, underwater arenas, and other quirky arenas.

  • Simple but chaotic gameplay – easy to pick up, impossible to stop laughing.

  • Relaxed vibes – watch the sunset while dunking on your mates.

If you’re looking for a light-hearted sports game that doesn’t take itself too seriously, Sunset Dunkin will keep you and your friends entertained for hours of ridiculous basketball fun.
